summary: OR Royalties Inc. (formerly Osisko Gold Royalties) filed a Form 6-K containing its interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, along with certifications and dividend press releases. The filing reports Q2 2026 revenues of $97.8M and net earnings of $61.4M, with no disclosed mergers, acquisitions, or strategic transactions. The registrant acts solely as a filer reporting routine financial results. No special-situation event is identified; the filing is an ordinary periodic report for a foreign private issuer.
